forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M546CTQCMXMGCC8FX2CWSFTJ
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: 'T1 follow-up 3/6: ManualRunClock.waitForSleepers waits also end on a failure event'
+---
+Source: task ^dbr1dqy (T1 audit, done). The audit comment "kinds of waits checked and left" names this helper change as not made: `ManualRunClock.waitForSleepers` with a failure event. Reason given: ManualRunClock has no form that ends on a task end.
+
+Rule T1: each wait in a test must also end on the failure event (run settle, session close, stream end), or the test must fail before it waits. A fixture closes also when the test body throws.
+Exception rule: first use an event that already exists (the session closes, the run settles, the feed ends). A hook only in test helpers is permitted. Do not change production code only for a test hook. When a case needs such a change, bring it to the coordinating session (swissarmyhammer-96) before you change it. Do not use `.timeLimit`, sleep, poll or retry. Run the full suite one time.
+Work rules: do the work in one agent. Do not run parallel agents on the tree. Edit files only with the edit tool. Do not run swift format.
+
+Helper (checked against the code on 2026-10-17):
+- `ManualRunClock.waitForSleepers(atLeast:)` is production code in the sibling package FoundationModelsExtras: ../FoundationModelsExtras/Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Hosting/RunClock.swift:177. Its wait is a `withCheckedContinuation` with no cancel handler. A cancel does not end it; only the next change of the set of waits resumes it.
+- A precedent in a test target exists: ../FoundationModelsMultitool/Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/Support/ManualRunClockWaits.swift adds `waitForSleepers(atLeast:orUntil:)` as a test-only extension. It starts the clock wait and the end wait in two tasks, goes on at the first, and cancels both.
+
+Failure event to use: the end of the call or answer that must put the wait on the clock (the answer task, or the run settle). It already exists.
+
+Plan:
+- [ ] Add a test-only extension on ManualRunClock in Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/Helpers (one new helper file, or in an existing helper file), with the same form as the Multitool precedent. Note in its doc: the inner clock-wait task stays suspended until the next change of the clock, because the production wait has no cancel handler. It holds no gate and does not block the test.
+- [ ] Decision point: a full fix (a cancel-aware `waitForSleepers` in RunClock.swift) is a change of production code only for a test hook. Do not make it. Bring it to the coordinating session (swissarmyhammer-96) only if the test-only form is not sufficient.
+- [ ] Change these sites to the new form, each with the failure event of its test:
+  - RespondRunPlaneDrainTests.swift:400
+  - QueuedPassStallWatchTests.swift:223, 268
+  - ToolDisplayDeliveryTests.swift:327
+  - InlineSettleGraceSessionTests.swift:157
+  - GenerationStallDiagnosticTests.swift:387, 480, 670
+- [ ] For each site where no event comes in the failure (gates of the test hold all work), leave the site and write the reason in a comment on this card.
+- [ ] Run the full suite one time (`swift test`). Record the counts in a comment. #t1-followup
\ No newline at end of file
